whatItIs.en: The potassium salt of sorbic acid, a preservative.
whatItIs.fr: Le sel de potassium de l'acide sorbique, un conservateur.

whyUsed.en: Slows mould and yeast in cheese, bakery products, dried fruit, sauces and drinks.
whyUsed.fr: Ralentit les moisissures et les levures dans les fromages, produits de boulangerie, fruits secs, sauces et boissons.

knownAndUnknown.en: Approved in the EU. EFSA re-evaluated sorbic acid and sorbates in 2015 and published a follow-up opinion afterwards. Regulators did not raise a safety concern at current uses.
knownAndUnknown.fr: Autorisé dans l'UE. L'EFSA a réévalué l'acide sorbique et les sorbates en 2015 et publié un avis complémentaire ensuite. Les autorités n'ont pas soulevé de problème de sécurité aux usages actuels.

sources.label: EFSA (2015): Scientific opinion on the re-evaluation of sorbic acid and sorbates (E 200-203)
EFSA: Opinion on the follow-up of the re-evaluation of sorbic acid (E 200) and potassium sorbate (E 202)

review.notes: Neither EFSA page was opened (titles confirmed by search). The 'no safety concern at current uses' conclusion is from memory: confirm in the 2015 opinion and the follow-up.
